plan.title: EMA Trend Gate on BTC — Multi-Timeframe Regime-Filtered Pullback
plan.objective: Test the EMA Trend Gate strategy (4h EMA regime filter + 1h RSI pullback entries) on BTCUSDT 1h data (43,789 bars, ~5 years from 2021-03-22 to 2026-03-21). The strategy generated 0.528 OOS Sharpe on ETH with 1216 trades; hypothesis is BTC's higher volatility will generate more trade opportunities and potentially higher risk-adjusted returns. This fills the BTC gap in the EMA Trend Gate strategy family and tests cross-asset generalization.
plan.hypothesis: BTC's higher volatility compared to ETH will generate more RSI pullback trade opportunities (target: >14.3 trades/window) and potentially higher risk-adjusted returns (target: OOS Sharpe >= 0.528, matching or exceeding ETH baseline). The 4h EMA regime filter will provide regime context that may improve trade quality on BTC's more volatile price action.
plan.strategy_rationale: Using existing EMA Trend Gate strategy that already demonstrated viability on ETH (0.528 OOS Sharpe, 85 windows, 1216 trades). This run tests cross-asset generalization to BTC, the highest-liquidity crypto pair. The strategy uses 4h EMA slope as regime filter (trending vs ranging) combined with 1h RSI pullback entries - a theoretically grounded approach that filters counter-trend trades. Previous lessons show RSI thresholds stable (CV=0.10-0.14) while hold_bars unstable (CV=0.54), so parameter optimization should focus on entry thresholds.

BTC's different volatility profile will reveal whether the strategy's regime filtering is asset-appropriate or overly restrictive.

implementation_steps: 1. Verify BTC deep data file exists and validate columns (timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume)
2. Create WFA config for BTC run: walk forward engine/strategies/ema_trend_gate_btc/wfa_config.yaml
3. Configure WFA with training_months=3, testing_months=1, step_months=1 for ~60+ windows
4. Run WFA using Windows venv: cd 'walk forward engine' && .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/ema_trend_gate_btc/wfa_config.yaml
5. Capture WFA output artifacts and aggregate metrics
